steps.instruction: Add the {coffee-powder} to the top chamber of a South Indian coffee filter and press down gently and evenly with the pressing disc.
Slowly pour the {hot-water} over the pressed coffee powder. Cover and let it drip through into the bottom chamber for 15-20 minutes to form the decoction.
Heat the {milk} in a saucepan until it comes to a boil, then let it simmer for a minute.
In each cup, pour 2-3 tablespoons of the decoction, then add the hot {milk} and {sugar} to taste.
Pour the coffee back and forth between the tumbler and the davara (cup and saucer) a few times to froth it up, then serve hot.
